name: odata-builder-t1-field-proxy-ts
instr:
Can't build filtered, paginated queries in our directory tool

Our directory tool uses `odata-builder` to turn search controls into OData requests. We need to combine field predicates with selection and pagination, and also support search expressions, related-entity expansions, sorting, and counts through the same query builder.

This is the kind of call our client makes:

```ts
import { OdataQueryBuilder } from 'odata-builder';
type Person = { name: string; age: number };
const query = new OdataQueryBuilder<Person>()
    .filter(f => f.where(p => p.age.ge(21)).and(p => p.name.contains('Lee')))
    .select('name').skip(20).top(10)
    .toQuery();
```

The documented result is a query string ready to append to our endpoint URL. Instead, constructing the builder throws `Error("not implemented")`. Other parts of the query-building flow still have the same placeholder bodies.

The affected files are under `src/query-builder/`: `index.ts`, `builder/filter-builder/field-proxy.ts`, `builder/filter-builder/filter-builder.ts`, `builder/search-expression-builder.ts`, `utils/expand/expand-util.ts`, `utils/filter/filter-visitor.ts`, `utils/orderby/orderby-utils.ts`, and `utils/skip/skip-utils.ts`. The main entry points are `OdataQueryBuilder`, `FilterBuilder`, and `SearchExpressionBuilder`.

Could you implement the remaining placeholders so these query options work together? Follow the behavior described in the doc comments and the `README.md` sections “Filter Syntax,” “Key Features,” “A
